description: This file defines the HomeScreen widget for a Flutter Tic Tac Toe app. It includes UI elements such as buttons to start game modes, view leaderboard, and reset scores, along with associated navigation and interaction logic.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: StatelessWidget that serves as the main menu for the Tic Tac Toe app, offering options to play against AI or another player, view leaderboard, and reset scores.

classes.name: _HomeCard
classes.description: A reusable widget representing a card on the home screen, encapsulating icon, title, subtitle, and tap behavior.

methods.name: _resetScores
methods.description: Asynchronously resets all scores via ScoreRepository and shows a confirmation snackbar.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the HomeScreen, including AppBar, buttons, and navigation logic.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the _HomeCard widget, displaying icon, title, subtitle, and handling tap events.
